相干散射必须把两个原子的复振幅先相加。b 是有符号相对散射振幅，e 是质量归一化: Coherent scattering adds the complex amplitudes of the two atoms before taking the squared modulus. Here b is a signed relative scattering amplitude and e is a mass-normalized eigenvector. The creation amplitude uses the complex conjugate of e in the convention of this exercise. Omitting the phase or conjugation can change amplitudes, intensities and extinctions. At an individual point the intensities may still agree accidentally, so check the intermediate complex values and other measurement points.
